summary_md: **Embodied AI Watch ([@embodiedaiwatch](https://x.com/embodiedaiwatch/status/2114986844672975180))** describes **VISTA**, a meta-agent framework that refines embodied-agent harnesses through active self-exploration, tracking lineage in a harness graph; the figure shows success climbing from 0/16 to 16/16 over revision rounds.

referenced_urls.title: VISTA: Active Exploration for Self-Improvement in Embodied Agents

relevance: Automated harness improvement driven by environment evidence.

media.description: Figure 1 of the VISTA paper: a meta-agent loop (Inspect, Develop, Interact, Revise) that turns an initial embodied-agent harness into a revised harness, with robot-arm frames showing success rising from 0/16 at baseline to 16/16 for the champion harness.
